comment: Recorded loops for the Ambience addon, built by .github/workflows/ambience-sounds.yml. Keys are AmbienceEffect keys. Every source must be CC0 on Freesound (the build fails otherwise). Each sound is turned into a seamless loop of loopSeconds with an equal-power crossfade of crossfadeSeconds, then encoded as Opus. A sound with several sources layers them (gain is relative). To try another recording, change the id and run the workflow again; the app picks up the new file from the manifest.

sources.note: INNORECORDS, forest after rain, drops falling on ferns
